description: Open a site's internal links directly, the way a refresh, bookmark or shared link does. Catches the single-page-app 404 (works when clicked, breaks on refresh) and names the host-specific fix, e.g. the vercel.json rewrite. Also checks that made-up URLs return a real 404.

paths.description: Extra paths to open directly, e.g. ["/about", "/pricing"]. Use this for client-rendered apps whose links are not in the HTML.

url.description: The page to check: a live URL, a preview deployment, or a local dev server like http://localhost:5173

name: check_routes
title: Check sub-pages survive a refresh
